linuxHolomatch.script:
wait 60
set sv_pure 0
set sv_maxclients 4
devmap hm_borg1
wait 120
screenshot mips_local
wait 3
status
renderer_switch
echo LINUX_MIPS_COMPLETE
quit

localEvidenceRetention.event: Six stock-asset runs during rectangular-mipmap validation reused these earlier scene homes. New run evidence was copied to distinct stvef-mips-stock folders. Original recorded hashes and numerical comparisons are preserved as historical observations.

safety.display: Inactive private Windows desktop or private Xvfb; never activated and no injected input.

limits: Synthetic texture comparison is not retail-image parity or campaign acceptance.
Stock runs establish bounded startup/render behavior; animated states are not synchronized.
Malformed image dimensions, gamma/color-shift callbacks, compressed upload formats and debug colored mips are outside the new compiled regression.
Windows RTX runs use SDR raster fallback, not native ray tracing.
Manual input/menu/listening/feedback hardware and campaign-wide gates remain open.
Previously recorded broad Linux-suite failures were not rerun or closed.
unrelatedIssues: Shared mip defects affect all seven profiles, beyond Elite Force.
Existing GCC unused FN_STVEFScissorRect warning remains.
Previously recorded corrupt st_21.bik, muted-audio/Janeway warnings and Windows x86 RT limit remain.
cleanup: Useful logs, scripts and runtime evidence retained in the designated project/test areas. Earlier cleanup attempts were automatically rejected as blocked by policy; no repeat cleanup was attempted for this slice.

manifest.acceptance: Physical input, menu save/load and rebinding, listening, force-feedback hardware and campaign-wide acceptance remain pending. SP capture startup/frame-phase differences and broader retail image parity remain open.
manifest.waveUpdate: Updated engine artifacts only; existing manual profiles and launchers retained. Physical input and listening remain pending.
manifest.feedbackUpdate: Verified engine artifacts refreshed; homes preserved. Installed FFC10 copied to independent test assets. Launch-SP defaults use_ff to 0; optional user-operated checks documented.
manifest.cadenceUpdate: Engine artifacts refreshed after full Windows suite, focused Linux SP tests, production cadence and retail save round-trip checks. Existing manual homes, saves, launchers and settings preserved.
manifest.imageAssessmentCorrection: Full-resolution corridor images agree across GLx/Vulkan/RTX within one channel value. The initial backend-specific contact-sheet assessment is retracted.
manifest.imageMipsUpdate: Engine artifacts refreshed after full Windows suite, Windows/Linux exact mip tests, six controlled GPU comparisons, and stock scene smoke checks. Existing manual homes, saves, settings and launchers preserved.
